info.title: Germany Career Crawler API
info.description: Company discovery and career crawling for German employers. Company data from OpenStreetMap is © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

post.description:
Discover companies with a website in the given regions from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API).

State codes (``DE-SN``) expand to their Kreise; each Kreis is one Overpass request.

post.description:
Queue one company for career-page scanning (verified websites only).

Unverified websites are verified first; the company is queued automatically if
verification succeeds.
Queue several companies (dashboard: 'Queue selected for vacancy scanning').
